types.purpose: Sends a message to the user, optionally with buttons.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The message. May contain {{variable}}. At most 300 characters.

fields.name: buttons
fields.description: Up to 6 buttons: {label, goto} leads to a block, {label, url} opens a web page.

exits.name: next
exits.meaning: continues right after the message is sent

exits.name: goto
exits.meaning: the block reached when the user clicks that button

rules: With at least one goto button it is a menu: next must be null.
It never stores what the user writes: use ask for questions.
Without next and without goto buttons it ends the conversation with that message.

types.purpose: Sends one message chosen at random among a few variants, so that a repeated message sounds less repetitive.

fields.name: texts
fields.description: 2 to 6 variants of the same message, each at most 300 characters. May contain {{variable}}.

exits.name: next
exits.meaning: continues right after the message is sent

rules: All variants say the same thing in different words.
It has no buttons: for a menu use replyv2.
Without next it ends the conversation with that message.

types.purpose: Asks the user a question and saves the answer in a variable.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The question, about one thing only.

fields.name: options
fields.description: Up to 6 quick replies; the chosen text is saved as the answer.

fields.name: saveTo
fields.description: snake_case variable that stores the answer.

exits.name: next
exits.meaning: continues after the user has answered

rules: next is mandatory.
To branch on the answer, put a jsoncondition2 right after it and compare with the exact option text.

types.purpose: Sets a variable to a constant value or to the value of another variable.

fields.name: destination
fields.description: snake_case variable to set.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Constant value. Exactly one of value and fromVariable.

fields.name: fromVariable
fields.description: Variable to copy. Exactly one of value and fromVariable.

exits.name: next
exits.meaning: continues after the variable is set

rules: Use it to record a value that a later block or the human operator needs, e.g. why the conversation was handed over.

types.purpose: Deletes a variable, so that a later question or check starts empty.

fields.name: variable
fields.description: Name of a variable set earlier in the flow, without {{ }}.

rules: Use it before asking again something already asked, or to clear the item of a finished loop.

types.purpose: Checks a condition on variables and continues on one of two branches.

fields.name: when
fields.description: The condition, in the when grammar.

rules: Both exits are mandatory.
Every variable in when is set earlier in the flow.

types.purpose: Lets an AI model choose among a few branches by understanding what the user wrote, when an exact condition on variables is not possible.

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: The text the AI must judge, with any context, e.g. "The customer wrote: {{request}}". Null means the user's last message.

fields.name: branches
fields.description: 2 to 6 branches {label, description, goto}: a short unique label, when that branch applies in plain words (no {{variable}}), and the block it leads to.

exits.name: goto
exits.meaning: the block of the chosen branch

rules: Use jsoncondition2 instead when the criterion is exact on variables, such as a quick-reply answer.
Descriptions never contain {{variable}}: put the data the AI needs in instructions.
Both exits are mandatory: fallback usually asks again, error leads to a helpful message or a handoff.

types.purpose: Checks whether the business is open now, according to the hours configured in Tiledesk.
rules: Both exits are mandatory.
The closed branch says so and offers an alternative.

types.purpose: Checks whether a human operator is available now.

exits.name: true
exits.meaning: at least one operator is available

rules: Both exits are mandatory.
The false branch offers an alternative, such as leaving a contact.

types.purpose: Searches a knowledge base for the answer to the user's question and saves it in kb_reply.

fields.name: knowledgeBase
fields.description: Name of a knowledge base listed in the context.

fields.name: question
fields.description: Question to search, may contain {{variable}}; null means the user's last message.

exits.name: true
exits.meaning: an answer was found, in kb_reply

rules: It does not show the answer: its true exit leads to a replyv2 whose text contains {{kb_reply}}.
Its false exit leads to an alternative: a handoff or a helpful message.
Both exits are mandatory.

types.purpose: Asks an AI model to write a text (a summary, a reply, a rewording, an extraction) and saves it in a variable.

fields.name: question
fields.description: The task for the AI, with the {{variable}} values it needs, e.g. "Summarise in two sentences: {{problem}}".

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: Role, tone and constraints for the AI. Null for none.

fields.name: saveTo
fields.description: snake_case variable that stores the text written by the AI.

fields.name: history
fields.description: true to give the AI the conversation so far; null otherwise.

exits.name: true
exits.meaning: the AI answered, the text is in saveTo

rules: It does not show the text: its true exit continues with a block that uses {{saveTo}}, usually a replyv2.
Its false exit leads to an alternative: a helpful message or a handoff.
To answer from a knowledge base use askgptv2 instead.
Both exits are mandatory.

types.purpose: Adds a text to a knowledge base of the project, e.g. information or a note collected in the conversation.

fields.name: knowledgeBase
fields.description: Name of a knowledge base listed in the context.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the content. May contain {{variable}}; a content with the same title is replaced.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The text to add. May contain {{variable}}.

rules: Put a {{variable}} in the title when every conversation must add its own content.
It is invisible to the user.

types.purpose: Reads or writes rows of a data table of the project.

fields.name: table
fields.description: Name of a data table listed in the context.

fields.name: operation
fields.description: get reads rows; insert adds a row; update changes the matching rows; upsert updates the matching row or adds it; delete removes the matching rows.

fields.name: match
fields.description: all: every condition must hold; any: at least one. Null means all.

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: Which rows: {column, operator, value}. operator: equal, not_equal, contains, starts_with, ends_with, greater_than, greater_or_equal, less_than, less_or_equal, exists, not_exists. value may contain {{variable}}; it is null for exists and not_exists.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Values to write: {column, value}; value may contain {{variable}}.

fields.name: saveTo
fields.description: snake_case variable that stores the result: the list of rows read, or the row written.

exits.name: true
exits.meaning: the operation succeeded, the result is in saveTo

rules: Use only columns of that table, as listed in the context.
get: conditions optional, data null. insert: conditions null, data required. update and upsert: conditions and data required. delete: conditions required, data null.
The rows read by get are a list: check with jsoncondition2 that it is not empty, then show each row with an iteration.
Both exits are mandatory.

types.purpose: Repeats a few blocks for every item of a list, such as the rows read by data_table.

fields.name: iterable
fields.description: Variable holding the list, set earlier (e.g. the saveTo of a data_table get), without {{ }}.

fields.name: itemVariable
fields.description: snake_case variable that holds the current item; its columns are {{item_variable.column}}.

exits.name: each
exits.meaning: the first block run for every item

rules: The blocks run for every item form a chain linked by next, and the last one has next = the iteration block.
That chain has no ask, no buttons, no branches and no terminal block.
Before the iteration, check with jsoncondition2 that the list is not empty: with an empty list the flow stops.

types.purpose: Pauses the flow for a few seconds before the next block.

fields.name: seconds
fields.description: Pause in seconds, from 0.5 to 15.

rules: Use it only when a pause helps the user, e.g. between two long messages. Never to pretend the agent is working.

types.purpose: Adds tags to the conversation or to the contact, to classify them for the operators.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: 1 to 5 short tags, without commas. May contain {{variable}}.

fields.name: target
fields.description: "request" tags the conversation, "lead" tags the contact.

rules: It is invisible to the user.

types.purpose: Saves data collected in the conversation into the contact (lead), where the operators see it.

fields.name: leadFields
fields.description: Pairs {field, value}: field is one of email, fullname, phone, company, streetAddress, city, region, zipcode, country; value is usually a {{variable}} set earlier.

rules: Each field appears at most once.
Use it after collecting the data, before the handoff or the end.

types.purpose: Sends an email, for example to notify the team or to send the user a summary.

fields.name: to
fields.description: An email address, or a {{variable}} holding one.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: At most 150 characters. May contain {{variable}}.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The email text, at most 1024 characters. May contain {{variable}}.

fields.name: replyTo
fields.description: Reply-to address, or a {{variable}} holding one; null for none.

exits.name: next
exits.meaning: continues after the email is queued

rules: Delivery is not confirmed: never tell the user that the email has arrived.

types.purpose: Writes a line in the flow log, for whoever tests or maintains the agent.

fields.name: level
fields.description: info, warn, error or debug.

fields.name: log
fields.description: The line to write. May contain {{variable}}.

rules: It is invisible to the user: never use it to tell the user something.

types.purpose: Clears the conversation history that ai_prompt reads when history is true.
rules: Use it only in flows with an ai_prompt whose history is true, so that the AI ignores the earlier part of the conversation.

types.purpose: Moves the conversation to a department, before handing it over to an operator.

fields.name: department
fields.description: Name of a department listed in the context.

rules: Use it only on the way to an agent block, optionally with ifonlineagentsv2 in between.

types.purpose: Hands the conversation over to a human operator. The agent's part ends here.
rules: Put a message (replyv2 or randomreply) before it that tells the user an operator is coming.

types.purpose: Puts the conversation back in the queue of unassigned conversations, without an operator. The agent's part ends here.
rules: Put a message before it that tells the user someone will reply as soon as possible.
To hand over to an available operator use agent instead.

types.purpose: Hands the conversation over to another agent of the project. This agent's part ends here.

fields.name: bot
fields.description: Name of an agent listed in the context.

rules: Put a message before it that tells the user who will continue.

types.purpose: Formally closes the conversation.
rules: Use it only when the brief asks to close the conversation.
Never right after a message the user must read.
